name: Budapest, including the Banks of the Danube, the Buda Castle Quarter and Andrássy Avenue
description: Budapest straddles the Danube, with hilly Buda on the west bank and flat Pest on the east. Buda's castle quarter crowns a ridge above the river, while Andrássy Avenue runs in a grand boulevard past opera houses and mansions. Roman Aquincum lies in the north of the city, and a ride on the 1896 metro line shows how many eras this capital layers together.
